title: SettingsDialog: Windows Credential Manager secrets are deleted/overwritten before Save — Cancel leaves config pointing at profiles whose secrets are gone
existing_state: Config changes are staged until BtnSave_Click's single _configService.Update (SettingsDialog.cs:2657-2663), but credential-store mutations are not. (1) Remove deletes secrets instantly: BtnVaultRemove_Click deletes all four vault auth credentials for the profile (851-858) and BtnNotificationRemove_Click deletes the webhook URL and SMTP password (1450-1455) — before any Save. (2) Rename of a notification profile migrate-deletes the old credential target during PersistNotificationProfileByIndex (1557-1564 -> MigrateNotificationCredential 1584-1593, which DeletePassword's the old target at 1591), and that persist fires on a mere list selection change (1396-1401). (3) Any secret typed or cleared in a textbox is written to / deleted from Credential Manager on selection change or Test Connection (PersistVaultProfileByIndex 1011-1017, SaveVaultCredential 1020-1027 deletes on empty). Concrete trigger: open Settings -> Vault tab -> select a profile -> Remove -> Cancel. The saved config still contains the profile (Save never ran), but its token/AppRole secret/LDAP password are permanently deleted — the next vault fetch fails auth with no obvious cause. Same for a renamed notification profile: rename A, click profile B, Cancel -> config still references 'A' but its webhook/SMTP password now lives only under the new name.
recommendation: Stage credential operations the same way config is staged: keep secret edits in memory (the textboxes already hold them), record pending deletes/migrations in a list, and flush all SavePassword/DeletePassword/migrate calls inside BtnSave_Click after ValidateVaultProfiles passes. Test Connection can keep reading from textboxes (it already does via the provider lambdas at 1062-1065), so nothing needs to be written for it to work.
user_benefit: A cancelled Settings dialog no longer silently destroys vault tokens and notification secrets, which today breaks vault-backed SSH runs and notification dispatch with no error pointing at the cause.

evidence.note: Notification rename migrate-deletes the old credential target on selection change
Secret writes/deletes happen in PersistVaultProfileByIndex; config itself is only committed in BtnSave_Click
